state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.
state.strategy: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.

powers.text:
No active Boast.

A card that grants Boast resets the counter and does not advance it. Multihit attacks count as one play. Embarrassment is Unplayable and Ethereal.
Strength adds additional damage to Attacks.

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.
state.strategy: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.

Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.
state.strategy: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.
state.strategy: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.
state.strategy: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.

powers.text:
[gold]Boast 1[/gold]
Attacks played: 1/2
Reward: 1 Strength
Failure: 1 Embarrassment

Boast N adds N stacks and resets progress. Play 2 subsequent Attacks this turn to gain 1 Strength per stack. End turn with stacks remaining: add that many Embarrassments to the TOP of your draw pile.
A card that grants Boast resets the counter and does not advance it. Multihit attacks count as one play. Embarrassment is Unplayable and Ethereal.
Absorbs 2 incoming attack damage after Block. Persists between turns.

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.
state.strategy: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.

powers.text:

state.rules: Play Slay the Spire 2 with the Dealmaker mod. Card text in the observation is authoritative. Boast N stacks a promise, resets its attack counter, and requires two subsequent attacks this turn; success gives N Strength, failure adds N Embarrassment to the top of the draw pile. Wall persists; ordinary Block normally expires. Favors retain and offer damage or Block. IOUs restrict non-Spin attacks while in hand and cost 1 energy to settle. Bargain: once per card per combat, when another card or Power exhausts it from hand during your turn, play it free then leave it exhausted. Self-exhaust and Ethereal do not trigger it. Use only visible information: draw-pile order and future RNG are unknown. Choose ONE offered action now, including its target. Re-evaluate after every action. Do not treat confidence as a probability of winning. Prioritize avoiding preventable lethal damage.
state.strategy: Maximize survival and the chance of winning the run. Build a coherent deck from the offers; do not force an archetype.
